item.title: OpenAI’s Dots Agent Takes Aim at Meta’s Muse AI
item.description: OpenAI unveiled Dots, a GPT‑6‑powered assistant with cute, customizable avatars, positioning it as a direct challenger to Meta’s Muse AI platform.
